title: CACE-Bench: A Synthetic Agentic Evaluation Benchmark for LLM Credit-Pipeline Agents
description: Compliance-Aware Credit-agent Evaluation (CACE-Bench): a fully synthetic, reproducible benchmark and generator for evaluating and auto-evolving LLM-agent credit pipelines under auditability constraints. v0.3 adds the data-availability axis: cases are drawn per country and each source class (open banking, alternative data, sanctions/PEP screening) is resolved by walking that country's provider fallback chain, with consent as a separate gate and a third ground-truth outcome (escalate) that is correct when the facts a decision needed were not obtainable. v0.4 adds an optional real_data module: a downloader and loaders for classic public credit datasets (German Credit, Taiwan default, Australian, Japanese/crx; Home Credit, GiveMeSomeCredit, Lending Club) for an external real-data baseline alongside the synthetic core - no external data is committed to the repository. Reports silent-decision rate, provenance completeness, over-escalation rate, hallucination rate, recovery rate, compliance false-positive rate and step-level correctness, all with 95% Wilson intervals, on 23,000 synthetic cases. No real personal or company data.
